design_v0.query_distribution: uniform over eight publicly indexed observation visits, disclosed after action
design_v0.instance_information: Public reference RGB; asset/model ID and true target identity excluded from policies
design_v0.layout: Eight named public visits; four behind each of two screen regions; enumerate all 70 left/right partitions
design_v0.action_timing: Memory decision precedes physical motion; public layout/history identical within each action pair
design_v0.after_action: Screen side becomes inaccessible within remaining horizon; opposite side remains inspectable
design_v0.oracle_diagnostic: Enumerate all 70 retained subsets, expected cost of a single uniformly sampled query
design_v0.public_rule: Retain the four public visits behind the screen to be closed
design_v0.full_archive: Keep every delivered reference RGB on CPU/disk with public visit index; retrieve one reference per query
design_v0.fairness: Same current observations, executor and one recalled-reference read budget; all persistent payload counted separately
design_v0.candidate_success_claim: None; physical feasibility and perception are not evaluated by this symbolic model

single_revision_v1.change: Replace public visit query with a delayed visual-instance query that has no exact visit key
mandatory_baselines: full raw-image archive with cached descriptors
unresolved: whether actions add value beyond query relevance
single_revision_v1.do_not_claim: Cheap descriptor search does not establish correct visual retrieval or full pipeline latency
single_revision_v1.review_limit: One design revision only; unresolved scientific admission does not trigger automatic large data collection

archive_cost_probe.image_source: Existing sixteen distinct mechanism RGB observations; reused only as byte-size and decode workloads
archive_cost_probe.descriptor_source: Synthetic normalized vectors for search cost only; no accuracy claim
archive_cost_probe.disk_reads: Original encoded images; warm OS page cache only; no cold-disk or durability claim
